description: This file defines a generic Cache interface providing asynchronous and synchronous methods for cache operations, including get, put, invalidate, and retrieving cache as a map.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A generic interface for a key-value cache with asynchronous and synchronous access methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a CompletableFuture with the value associated with the key, or empty if not present.

methods.name: getIfPresent
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the key in a future if present, without calling cache loader.

methods.name: getBlocking
methods.description: Returns the value directly, or empty if not present, in a blocking manner.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the specified key from the cache.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates a value with a key in the cache.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe view of the cache's entries as a map.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Invalidates a collection of keys from the cache.
